title: Disaster Assistance Finder – Privacy Collection Notice
summary: This notice explains how Service NSW collects and uses personal information when you use the Disaster Assistance Finder.

more_info.text: you can access and seek correction of the information
privacy enquiries or complaints can be made.
Read the Service NSW privacy statement for more information on how:
You can call Service NSW on 13 77 88.
Service NSW is located at 2-24 Rawson Place Sydney NSW 2000.

faqs.q: What information is collected when I use the Disaster Assistance Finder?
faqs.a: Service NSW collects the type of disaster impacting you, how the disaster has impacted you, whether you are of Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander origin, your email address, full name, phone number, and residential address.

faqs.q: How will my personal information be used?
faqs.a: The information is used to provide personalized results on eligible assistance types, to email a link to your personalized results, and if you book an appointment, staff may use it to provide further information on eligible assistance types.

faqs.q: Do I have to provide this information?
faqs.a: You may be required to provide this information to receive personalized recommendations or further information on the types of assistance for which you may be eligible.
